verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
All praise is for Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Master of the Day of Judgment.
You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path.

verses.ar: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
verses.en: The path of those You have blessed, not of those who earned anger, nor of those who went astray.
verses.transliteration: Sirata lladhina an'amta 'alayhim ghayri l-maghdubi 'alayhim wa la d-dallin

Allah, the Eternal, on whom all depend.
He does not give birth, nor was He born.
And there is no one equal to Him.

verses.en: Say, 'I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind.'
The King of mankind.
The God of mankind.
From the harm of the sneaky whisperer.
Who whispers into the hearts of people.
Whether from jinn or people.

verses.en: Say, 'I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak.'
From the harm of all that He has created.
And from the harm of the night when it grows dark.
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab

verses.en: And from the harm of those who blow on knots.
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri n-naffathati fi l-'uqad

verses.en: And from the harm of an envier when he envies.
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad

verses.en: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
verses.transliteration: Tabbat yada abi lahabin wa tabb

verses.ar: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.en: His wealth and what he earned will not help him.
verses.transliteration: Ma aghna 'anhu maluhu wa ma kasab

verses.en: He will enter a Fire of blazing flames.
And so will his wife, the carrier of firewood.
Around her neck is a rope of palm-fibre.

verses.en: By time,
Indeed, mankind is in loss,

verses.ar: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ

verses.transliteration: Illa lladhina amanu wa 'amilu s-salihati wa tawasaw bi l-haqqi wa tawasaw bi s-sabr

verses.en: For the familiarity of the Quraish,
Their familiarity with the journey of winter and summer,
Let them worship the Lord of this House,
verses.transliteration: Fa l ya'budu rabba hadha l-bayt

verses.ar: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ

verses.transliteration: Alladhi at'amahum min ju'in wa amanahum min khawf

verses.en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
That is the one who drives away the orphan,
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray,
Who are heedless of their prayer,
Those who make a show [of their deeds],
And withhold simple assistance.

verses.en: Say, 'O you who disbelieve,
I do not worship what you worship,
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.'

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ
verses.en: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephant?
verses.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa fa'ala rabbuka bi-as-habi l-fil

verses.en: Did He not make their plan go totally astray?
And He sent against them flocks of birds,
Striking them with stones of baked clay,
Leaving them like chewed-up straw.
Indeed, We sent it down on the Night of Decree.
And what will make you realize what the Night of Decree is?
verses.transliteration: Wa ma adraka ma laylatu l-qadr

verses.ar: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
verses.en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
verses.transliteration: Laylatu l-qadri khayrun min alfi shahr

verses.ar: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
verses.en: The angels and the Spirit descend in it, by the permission of their Lord, for every matter.
verses.transliteration: Tanazzalu l-mala'ikatu wa-r-ruhu fiha bi-idhni rabbihim min kulli amr

verses.en: Peace it is, until the break of dawn.
By the fig and the olive,
And Mount Sinai,
And this secure city,

verses.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, We created the human being in the best form.
verses.transliteration: Laqad khalaqna l-insana fi ahsani taqwim

verses.en: Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low,

verses.ar: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.en: Except those who believe and do good — for them is a never-ending reward.
verses.transliteration: Illa-lladhina amanu wa 'amilu s-salihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnun

verses.en: So what makes you deny the Judgment to come?
Is Allah not the most just of judges?
By the morning brightness,
And the night when it grows still,
Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor is He displeased.
verses.transliteration: Ma wadda'aka rabbuka wa ma qala

verses.en: And the Hereafter is better for you than this present life.
verses.transliteration: Wa la-l-akhiratu khayrun laka mina l-ula

verses.en: And your Lord will give you so much that you will be pleased.
Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?
And find you lost and guide you?
And find you in need and enrich you?
So as for the orphan, do not oppress him.
And as for the one who asks, do not turn him away.
And as for the blessing of your Lord, speak of it.
Have We not expanded your chest for you?
And lifted off your burden
Which weighed heavily on your back?
And raised your renown for you.
So surely, with hardship comes ease.
Surely, with hardship comes ease.
So once you are free, then strive,
And turn devoutly to your Lord.
